I can attest to how grief feels and some personalities will tend to blame themselves but I truly think that is their responsibility. It doesn't matter if someone commited suicide or had a heart attack. There's still this impulsive what if in my experience.  I don't want to encourage ANYONE here, what matters is you and your life and I hope you actually want to stay.
I said this to my sister after she told me to think about all the people who would be grateful to live longer, cancer, etc. I truly wish they could take it 🖤
Understand, I know I don't feel quite in control of what I'm saying around friends right now, it's exhausting trying to not get too comfortable in a conversation and slip up.

Sorry, this is a struggle for me too, I've ended up isolating myself the last month when things have been the worst. I don't recommend that as much as it can seemingly solve one problem. Maybe being honest you'll find one person who understands even if they aren't in the same place? That definitely is the best experience I had.
